branding.title: Red Dead Vista
branding.intro: A captured scene from the frontier. Wander the space at your own pace — tap or click the ground to walk, drag to look around.

W A S D to move · drag to look around

tags.title: The Overlook
tags.text: The lowest point of the capture, where the ground opens toward the valley. A good place to get your bearings.

tags.title: East Ridge
tags.text: Rock face rising along the eastern edge. Notice how the reconstruction holds detail even on the steep surfaces.

tags.title: Timberline
tags.text: Scattered trees mark the far treeline. Splats like these are hardest to capture cleanly — look for the soft, feathered edges.

tags.title: Canopy
tags.text: The highest tagged point, up among the branches. Hotspots fade with distance, so this one grows clearer as you approach.
